source: Source: Martin Lindstrom, Brandwashed (2011); NPR interview (Oct 23, 2011)

scenes.text: You came in for milk. You're leaving with forty dollars of stuff.
scenes.head: WHY SHOPPING CARTS KEEP GETTING BIGGER

scenes.text: Marketing consultant Martin Lindstrom says when stores doubled cart size, shoppers bought up to 40% more.
scenes.say: Marketing consultant Martin Lindstrom says when stores doubled cart size, shoppers bought up to forty percent more.

scenes.text: That's his claim, from his book. Not a published study.
My theory? A half-empty cart looks unfinished. So you finish it.
Same store. Same milk. Bigger cart, bigger bill.
The fix? Grab a basket. Your arms will tell you when to stop.
